prompt: 哪个单词的意思是「生活方式」？

prompt: 「stress」的中文意思是哪一个？
explanation: stress 的意思是压力。

prompt: 选择表示「日常安排」的单词。
explanation: 表示日常安排的单词是 routine。

prompt: 哪个单词的意思是「平衡」？
explanation: balance 的意思是平衡。

prompt: 哪个单词的意思是「焦虑」？
explanation: anxiety 的意思是焦虑。

prompt: 「nutrition」的中文意思是哪一个？
explanation: nutrition 的意思是营养。

prompt: 选择表示「充足的」的单词。
explanation: 表示充足的的单词是 sufficient。

prompt: 哪个单词的意思是「使恢复精神」？
explanation: refresh 的意思是使恢复精神。

prompt: Only then ___ how tired he was. 横线处填哪一个？
explanation: Only then 开头，用 did he realise。

prompt: I need sufficient sleep. 对方也是，哪一句正确？
explanation: 同样需要，用 So do I。So I do 是强调我确实如此，主语没倒。

prompt: He cannot keep the routine. 她也不能，哪一句正确？
explanation: 否定的“也不”用 Neither can she。

prompt: 哪一句是正确的？

choices.text: Only after a walk she felt refreshed
Only after a walk did she felt refreshed
Only after a walk did she feel refreshed
Only she felt refreshed after a walk as inversion

explanation: Only after a walk 是状语提前，用 did she feel。
verify: "Only after a walk did she feel refreshed"

prompt: There ___ a quiet garden behind the gym. 横线处填哪一个？
explanation: 主语 a quiet garden 是单数，用 stands。

prompt: 哪一句是倒装？

choices.text: An old tree stands in front of the library
In front of the library stands an old tree
Stands in front an old tree the
In front of the library an old tree stands it

explanation: 地点短语在句首，动词 stands 在主语前面。
verify: "In front of the library stands an old tree"

prompt: On the wall ___ two posters about nutrition. 横线处填哪一个？
explanation: 主语 two posters 是复数，用 hang。

prompt: 这种倒装通常放在句首的是什么？
explanation: 地点状语或 there 提前，主语后置。

prompt: 想说直到那时他才意识到自己的压力，哪一句合适？

choices.text: Only then he realised his stress
Only then did he realise his stress
Did he realise only then not

explanation: Only then did he realise。
verify: "Only then did he realise his stress"

prompt: 对方说需要充足睡眠，你也一样，应回答什么？

choices.text: So I do if you mean I really do and the grammar is the short answer of agreement wait no

explanation: 同意对方的需要，用 So do I。

prompt: 想说图书馆前有一棵树，并用倒装，哪一句合适？

choices.text: In front of the library an old tree stands quietly as normal order
Stands an old tree front in
In front of the library stands an old tree

explanation: 地点在句首时动词在单数主语前。There stand 与单数主语不一致。
verify: "In front of the library stands an old tree"

prompt: 想建议用步行缓解焦虑，哪一句合适？

A short walk can refreshed you and reduce anxiety

An short walk can refresh you and reduce anxiety

prompt: Only after he changed his routine did Tom sleep well. He says he needs sufficient nutrition, and so does his sister. Behind the dormitory stands a garden where they walk. 宿舍后面有什么？

choices.text: Only after he changed his routine did he sleep well, so does his sister need good nutrition, and behind the dormitory stands a garden

explanation: 三个要点都要出现。
verify: "Only after he changed his routine did he sleep well, so does his sister need good nutrition, and behind the dormitory stands a garden"

prompt: 建议里用 only 倒装，哪一句正确？

prompt: 哪一句适合作为建议的第一句？
